description:
One `breaking-change:events` entry: a detector naming a commit that broke the default branch, or the postmortem
that closes the commit's row. Detector and outcome are the producer's own strings.

event.description: Which of the two it is.
event.title: Event

commit.description: The merge commit that broke the branch.
commit.title: Commit

time.description: When it was recorded, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

source.description: The producer that posted it through the CloudEvents ingest.
source.title: Source

detector.description: What saw it; required to record a break.
detector.title: Detector

outcome.description: How the break ended, such as `revert-opened`.
outcome.title: Outcome

pr.description: The pull request that merged the commit.
pr.title: Pr

task.description: The task of the commit; on a postmortem, the postmortem task.
task.title: Task

evidence.description: A link that shows the break.
evidence.title: Evidence

title: BreakingChangeEvent
